canonical_project: J&K Data Centre / Data Recovery Centre networking and security modernisation
owner: Jammu and Kashmir e-Governance Agency / Information Technology Department
notes: Official J&K eProcurement (jktenders.gov.in) tender for supply/installation/migration/testing/commissioning of networking and security equipment for the Data Centre and Data Recovery Centre established at Srinagar and Jammu respectively (tender value ~INR 9.5 crore). Infrastructure modernisation, not new MW-scale capacity.
